title: Noise stability as a spectral moment
statement: For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and every Boolean function $f$, the noise stability of its real-valued sign interpretation equals the expected value of $\rho^{|S|}$ when $S$ is drawn from the spectral sample of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the Boolean cube
